gaps.title: Add TraitNeuralExpression for EEG-to-blendshape mapping (A-009 example-driven request)
gaps.description: While refreshing examples/emotion/03-emotion-regulation.refreshed.holo ('Empathy Architecture'), the scene wanted to drive NPC facial blendshapes directly from live EEG alpha/theta power ratios. No Trait*.ts implements this. Proposed API: @neural_expression { sources: ['eeg_alpha', 'eeg_theta'], blendshape_map: { eeg_alpha: { browDown: '-0.6x', jawOpen: '-0.4x' }, eeg_theta: { cheekPuff: '0.3x' } }, smoothing_hz: 10 }. Would complement @biofeedback by providing a continuous sub-frame-latency blendshape layer driven by biometric state.
